Problem Statement:
There are N hills each of height H[i] 1<=i<=N.Peter is scaling these hills and would like to ask Q questionsEach question is of the form L,R to know if he can jump from hill L to R.Peter can jump from hill L to hill R if there is no hill in between that has height of greater than the height of the first hill . i.e ( H[i]<=H[L] L+1<=i<=R )Help Peter find the answer for all his questions 
Input Description:
The first line contains a single integer N - the number of hillsThe second line contains N integers the heights of each hillThe third line contains a number P - the number of questionsThe next P lines contains two integers L, R- the height of the hills he wants to jump between 
Output Description:
The output must contain P lines- each line the answer for a questionIn each line output “YES” (without quotes) if he can jumpOr “NO” (without quotes”) if he can’t. 
Explanation:
Peter can jump from hill 1 to hill 2 since hill 1 has height 3 and hill 2 has height 2 .Peter cannot jump from hill 3 to hill 4 since height of hill 4 is greater than hill 3 
Sample Input:
4
3 2 2 3
2
1 2
3 4 
Sample Output:
YES
NO
